title: Chats: one list of every chat, newest first, with its state, ticket and worktree

steps.caption: Every chat of every worktree in one list, newest first
A new reply you haven't opened yet: blue, and its title in bold
Waiting for you, working, stopped, finished…
…and ended chats, muted at the bottom
Each row's worktree is a chip in that worktree's colour
An agent's ticket from its first line, here BL-11 running in main: a click opens it
Picking a worktree tab doesn't filter the list
New chat… asks which worktree, the selected tab's first
Flotilla's agents are greyed with a gear; the toggle hides them
